profile.headline: Freelance Web Developer + Admissions Manager + Salesforce Administrator/Developer at Bauman College
profile.summary:
“If I had an hour to solve a problem I'd spend 55 minutes thinking about the problem and 5 minutes thinking about solutions.” 
― Albert Einstein

positions.title: Admissions Manager + Advisor Salesforce Administrator/Developer
positions.description:
-Design, setup, and maintain Salesforce.
-Keep up-to-date on technology trends, developments & best practices.
-Research, compare and enable 3rd party offerings using the AppExchange.
-Perform user training sessions for employees to utilize Salesforce.
-Manage ongoing support request and administrative needs of users.
-Configure page layouts, workflows, document templates, record types, and data fields.
-Ensure data integrity through the appropriate use of de-duping, loading and exporting tools, for 
 bulk of data using Data Loader.
-Develop, launched, and manage in-depth dashboards and reports for all team functions on both 
  management and individual levels.
 -Supervise and evaluate Enrollment Coordinator, Admissions Advisors, and Appointment Setters.
 -Research, develop, implement, and manage sales procedures/tools for the Admissions
  Department.
 -Upkeep all admissions/sales related documents.
 -Maintain all website and catalog language pertaining to admissions and enrollment.

company.name: Bauman College: Holistic Nutrition and Culinary Arts

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
-Create site layout and user interface using HTML and CSS practices.
-Create eye-catching and functional digital design concepts across various platforms to strengthen 
 company brand and identity.
-Design, implement and monitor web pages and sites for continuous improvement.
-Take concepts and produce design mockups and prototypes to strengthen designs, enhance user 
 experiences and improve site interactions.

positions.title: Lead Counselor
positions.description:
Supervisory, administrative and professional work planning, directing and organizing the operations and activities in a community-based group home that provides rehabilitative services for adolescent males. Assumes legal custody of group home residents; establishes guidelines and protocols, provides day-to-day supervision and monitoring of all group home programs, including: individual, family and group counseling programs, recreational, social, aftercare, educational and employment programs; hires, trains, assigns and reviews work and evaluates all group home staff, including professional, technical, and administrative support employees; coordinates psychiatric, medical, educational and physical services for group home residents; develops and monitors facility and program budget; provides liaison with other professionals, the court system, schools and the public; and maintains program and individual client records, and statistics in accordance with federal, state and local regulations. An employee in this class is “on call” for emergency situations on a 24-hour basis.

Major duties:
-Plans, implements and evaluates the programs, services, and activities provided in the group home.
-Provides supervisory oversight, technical guidance, and advice to staff.
-Maintains group home facilities and performs related administrative duties.
-Provides liaison with the public, police, courts, schools and other professionals.
